Title: security(auth): disallow header-simulation auth in production
Body:
## Context
Header-driven auth simulation is currently available and default role fallback is applied in middleware.

## Scope
- Enforce session-only auth mode in production.
- Fail fast at startup when insecure auth mode is configured.
- Add tests for environment guard behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Production startup fails when header-simulation auth is enabled.
- /api/auth/me in production does not honor role headers.
- CI includes regression tests for auth mode guardrails.

Title: security(http): add baseline hardening middleware and request limits
Body:
## Context
Current app boot path is minimal and should be hardened for production web exposure.

## Scope
- Add security headers middleware.
- Add body-size limits and deterministic malformed payload handling.
- Add request timeout / abusive request protections.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Security headers are present on API/static responses.
- Oversized request tests return 413 reliably.
- Existing smoke tests remain green.

Title: security(secrets): remove plaintext SMTP password storage
Body:
## Context
SMTP password is currently stored as plaintext in smtp_settings.

## Scope
- Move SMTP secret to managed secret source OR encrypted-at-rest strategy.
- Add key rotation/operational runbook.
- Ensure logs/responses never expose secret values.

## Acceptance Criteria
- No plaintext SMTP password in DB snapshots.
- Rotation path verified in staging.
- SMTP test flow remains functional.

Title: ci: add lint, SAST, dependency and secret scanning gates
Body:
## Context
CI currently runs migrate, syntax checks, and tests only.

## Scope
- Add lint + formatting checks.
- Add dependency vulnerability scan.
- Add secret scan and SAST stage.
- Enforce fail-on-threshold policy.

## Acceptance Criteria
- PRs fail on configured quality/security threshold violations.
- CI summary surfaces security and quality results.

Title: devops(container): non-root runtime + reproducible installs
Body:
## Context
Container build/runtime posture should be hardened for production standards.

## Scope
- Run app as non-root.
- Use lockfile-driven deterministic install strategy.
- Add image scanning in CI.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Container runs with non-root UID.
- Build reproducibility documented and validated.
- No untriaged critical image vulnerabilities in CI.

Title: test(db): expand integration suite beyond schema_migrations existence
Body:
## Context
DB integration currently validates only schema_migrations existence.

## Scope
- Add integration tests for key constraints/indexes and critical SQL paths.
- Add auth/session table behavior checks.
- Validate migration invariants for core entities.

## Acceptance Criteria
- >=10 critical DB invariants covered.
- Integration suite catches representative migration regressions.

Title: test(api): add real-DB contract coverage for critical admin/auth flows
Body:
## Context
Many smoke tests stub pool.query heavily and provide limited SQL confidence.

## Scope
- Add real-DB contract tests for auth/admin/import-export critical endpoints.
- Keep fast mocked tests for unit-speed feedback.
- Document target test pyramid.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Critical flows have non-mocked integration coverage.
- Test strategy docs updated with explicit layering.

Title: architecture(modules): extract projects/challenges/assignments/import-export from app.js
Body:
## Context
Known technical debt: app.js still contains large legacy route surface.

## Scope
- Create dedicated modules (routes/service/repo/schema) for remaining legacy domains.
- Keep app.js focused on composition/bootstrap.
- Preserve API compatibility with tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Legacy route families moved to modules.
- No SQL in extracted route handlers.
- Module-level tests added.

Title: architecture(governance): introduce ADR process + boundary checks
Body:
## Context
Need durable engineering governance for senior-level review readiness.

## Scope
- Add ADR template and contribution policy.
- Add lightweight architecture boundary checks in CI.
- Require ADR for auth/data/infra-impacting decisions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- ADR docs established and referenced in CONTRIBUTING.
- CI blocks configured boundary violations.

Title: observability(logging): structured logs + correlation IDs
Body:
## Context
Operational diagnostics need consistent, queryable logs.

## Scope
- Add request correlation ID middleware.
- Emit structured JSON logs with redaction policy.
- Standardize error event schema.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Every request includes correlation ID in logs.
- Error logs include actionable structured context.

Title: observability(metrics): add readiness/liveness split and core service metrics
Body:
## Context
Production operations require measurable health and alerting signals.

## Scope
- Add separate readiness and liveness endpoints.
- Add core metrics (latency, error rate, auth failures, DB timings).
- Create baseline alerting policy.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Health semantics documented and orchestrator-compatible.
- Dashboard + basic alerts available for golden signals.

Title: i18n(ci): enforce locale key parity in CI
Body:
## Context
Localization docs call out completeness checks as a rollout step.

## Scope
- Add script to validate key parity between en/de.
- Fail CI on missing keys.
- Add developer-friendly output for missing/extra keys.

## Acceptance Criteria
- CI blocks merges with locale key mismatch.
- Script documented in README/testing docs.

Title: i18n(ux): add pseudo-locale mode for hardcoded-text and overflow detection
Body:
## Context
Pseudo-locale helps catch hardcoded strings and layout truncation early.

## Scope
- Add pseudo-locale catalog/mode.
- Add optional QA route or toggle.
- Document manual QA checklist for pseudo-locale runs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Pseudo-locale can be enabled in dev/staging.
- QA can identify untranslated strings and clipping regressions quickly.
